headline: A law renames the Pickens, South Carolina, post office after Specialist Four Charles Johnson.
what_it_does: The law gives a official name to the U.S. Postal Service facility at 110 Johnson Street in Pickens, South Carolina. The building will be called the Specialist Four Charles Johnson Post Office. It does not change postal services, mail delivery, or postal rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on October 11, 2022.
